baseline: record 96, production default recall limit 3 / excerpt budget 1800
development: Independent synthetic fixtures only; old 200 scored questions excluded from tuning.
qualification: A new balanced 100 classic LongMemEval_S +100 MemoryAgentBench Accurate_Retrieval questions, excluding earlier IDs and normalized question text, selected by metadata/hash before inference.
comparison: Same exact NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning reader and frozen judge profile, paired baseline/current production inputs; report regressions, resource and token/latency cost separately.
scope: Memory RAG only, no CU/UI; no release or official leaderboard claim.
policy: Freeze selected question IDs and implementation before inspecting qualification answers. Retain every valid prediction including wrong answers; retries by validity only. If a candidate does not qualify, keep results and do not tune on them.
